message.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

You offered us your extensive inventory and reliable delivery, and we want to build on that. The options below bring your plant a binding volume over a long contract term, as business on top of what you supply us today, and Option A secures it for you.

On the cost side:
Our forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc rises 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).

On price history:
Our orders of Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2025-05-26 (po:4500012506-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013479-10) and EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-09-30 (po:4500014475-10): the price has been unchanged.

Our orders of Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-20), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2025-06-02 (po:4500012538-10), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-01-30 (po:4500013504-10) and EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-10): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.20; payment 90 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.15; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.17; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 36 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Beyond the options, there are things we are glad to do at no cost to you. We will act as a reference customer for your other clients, share our rolling forecast with you every quarter, approve your invoices within days of receipt, and name you a preferred supplier for this part family.

Since you may need to take this to a colleague, we would be grateful if you would put Option A before the person who decides on your side.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
message.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As the responsible representative for this account, I have reviewed your proposal and the verified data. We welcome the 36-month contract, the binding volume of 30,000 units per year, and the goodwill items you offered. While your target prices cannot be met, we can accommodate the 45-day payment term and offer €5.58 per unit for Option B. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

Our offer is a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

We also have an alternative: a price of €5.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Option C: unit price EUR 5.35; payment 90 days net; contract term 36 months.
